subject.title: Livermore Valley Joint Unified School District Board, Area 5

text: My education and qualifications are: As a Livermore mother of two elementary students and an aunt to many children in our District, practicing chiropractor, small-business owner, and current LVJUSD Board Member, I am running for re-election because our kids deserve better. I have lived here nearly 15 years. In 2024 I earned the most votes of any candidate despite heavy special-interest opposition. I am the only board member who has earned a Master’s in Governance through the California School Boards Association and have completed the Livermore Leadership Program. I have been the consistent voice for academic excellence, campus safety, and fiscal responsibility. I serve on our schools’ PTA, the Little League Board, and my church’s Children’s Ministry. I regularly visit schools, work alongside teachers & staff on the Math Task Force, and cheer students on at sports, music, STEAM events, and Special Olympics. My husband and I donate our time and resources to schools, troops, sports teams, nonprofits, and individual students needing support. I will keep working to keep girls safe in their sports and private spaces, strengthen reading and math, and put students first—not ideology. I am the only candidate who has already stood firm under pressure. With your support I will continue this work through 2030. I would be honored to have your vote. DrDeenaK4LVJUSD.com

text: My education and qualifications are: I currently serve on the Livermore Valley Joint Unified School District Board of Trustees and am running for the Area 5 seat to continue that work. I immigrated to the United States at age twenty and learned English as a second language, which informs how I see every student’s potential. I served three years as PTSA president at Livermore High School and on the School Site Council there and at East Avenue Middle School. As the spouse of a high school teacher, the father of a current student and two district graduates, I am invested in our schools every day. My work on the board is grounded in good data, steady and pragmatic judgment, and a collaborative culture that keeps the focus on students. My priorities are strengthening education quality and results, supporting innovative teaching, and making sure every student, regardless of background, has what they need to succeed. I will keep showing up as a reasonable, practical voice for students, educators, and parents. I would appreciate your vote to continue this work.

text: My education and qualifications are: My daughter is a sophomore at Livermore High. That’s why I’m running. I’m a builder, not a politician. For thirteen years I ran construction and facilities operations, most recently as Director of Operations and Production, managing crews and budgets where going over wasn’t an option. I hold a California General Contractor’s license. I know what deferred maintenance actually costs, what a fair contract looks like, and how to spot a padded bid. Our district spends serious money on facilities, bonds, and vendor contracts. That’s your money. I’ll read every line of it. My priorities are common sense: dollars in the classroom and in front of teachers, campuses that are safe and well maintained, and a budget any parent can actually understand. Trades and career pathways for the kids who aren’t headed to a four-year school — because we need electricians and welders as much as we need engineers. I’m a small business owner. I make payroll. I earn trust one commitment at a time. I’ll show up, ask hard questions, and give you a straight answer even when it isn’t the popular one. I’d be honored to earn your vote.
